name: Quantum Information Processing and Machine Learning
description: This course introduces core quantum concepts such as superposition, entanglement, and quantum circuits, alongside classical ML fundamentals. Students learn quantum data encoding, quantum algorithms, and hybrid quantum-classical models using frameworks like Qiskit (and/or PennyLane). Emphasis is placed on real-world applications in image analysis. The course includes hands-on projects and explores current limitations and future directions, preparing students for research or development in the emerging field of quantum-enhanced AI.
